scenarios.name: Production defaults block missing price/delivery rules
Real Auth identity receives authoritative integer-paise quote
Lost-response retry creates one order and one hold
Direct REST paid-state forgery and cross-customer reads are denied
Unknown result is recoverable by the same request key after quotes expire
Recovery and reservation history expose only the real owner
Price changes require a new customer review
Two genuinely waiting requests compete safely for the last item
A coupon expiring while stock is locked cannot be used
A workspace revoked during a stock-lock wait cannot create an order
Unpaid release and expiry return stock without fake refunds
Signed-out JWT is rejected by the database session check
